configuration.discovery_revisit_rule: zero at any previously paid node; full-circle planar lidar viewpoint already paid
configuration.inference_status: standard hierarchical generalized Bayes; not calibrated sensor likelihood
configuration.initial_semantic_prior: equal mixture of geometry prior and nominal class prior
configuration.initialization_priority: least attempted eligible instance, then full macro plus return cost
configuration.initialization_progress: first actual reliable plane per observed instance only
configuration.instance_covariance_assumption: class reliability induces dependence; no summed marginal variance penalty
configuration.lookahead_reward: final view only; divided by both macros and full-pose return
configuration.macro: move to selected pose, execute one extra paid observe, then replan
configuration.measurement_acquisition_scope: shared paid geometry initialization; not semantic utility
configuration.nbv_scope: myopic geometry-only shared nominal surface gain; CPU mechanism baseline
configuration.planning_horizon: one prototype diagnosis followed by one budget-feasible view
configuration.route_cache_scope: one synchronous global selection; cleared before new observed safety updates
configuration.tie_unit: unique executable target pose; retain maximum score per target
configuration.uncertainty_status: posterior nominal-area dispersion; no learned or calibrated uncertainty
configuration.utility_units: weighted 2D unknown-cell m2 plus 3D predicted-new-surface m2
configuration.weights_status: declared design constants; no fitted calibration or performance claim

observed_instances.detection: paid exact-color marker bootstrap plus unique depth-support overlap; not natural segmentation

structure_belief.inference_status: standard hierarchical Bayes using generalized geometry evidence
